title: The bulk bar: where it sits, its count, and the disabled button tooltip
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. You hold the "Part Library & Inventory - Delete" permission (needed to change status/tracking).
  3. Seed a few inventory parts (tag throwaway data "ZZAUTOTEST", e.g. part number "ZZAUTOTEST-PKG-1", name "ZZAUTOTEST package part") via New Inventory Part. Turn Deactivate parts on.
custom_steps:
1. Read where the bulk bar sits and where the search/filter row moves.
  2. Read the bar left-to-right (count badge + "selected", divider, blue action button).
  3. Tick rows and watch the number update.
  4. With nothing ticked, hover the action button and read the tooltip; repeat on the Inactive tab.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The bulk bar spans the full width directly under the Active/Inactive tabs (search & filter row moves beneath it), near-black with white text (white with near-black text in dark theme), 8px rounded corners.
  • Left to right it shows the ticked-row count in a round badge + "selected", a thin divider, and a blue "Deactivate" (Active) / "Activate" (Inactive) button; the count updates as rows are ticked; while nothing is ticked the button is disabled and hovering it shows "Tick the parts to deactivate" / "Tick the parts to activate".

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 2 (Deactivate parts); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R7: “While the mode is on, the bulk bar spans the full width of the list directly under the Active and Inactive tabs, and the search and filter row moves down beneath it. The bar is near-black (#121926) with white text in the light theme and white with near-black text in the dark theme, with 8px rounded corners.”
  • S2-R7a: “From left to right the bar shows: the number of ticked rows in a round badge followed by the word "selected", a thin divider, and a blue button reading "Deactivate" on the Active tab or "Activate" on the Inactive tab. The number updates as the user ticks.”
  • S2-R8: “That button is disabled while no row is ticked. Hovering it then shows "Tick the parts to deactivate" on the Active tab and "Tick the parts to activate" on the Inactive tab.”
